headline: Exchange Inflows Rose To 570.6 Million Dollars As Binance Took In 438.0 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 570.6 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.2127 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, up from 306.8 million dollars and 0.1146 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the larger print means that arrival sped up. Binance took in 438.0 million dollars and Bitstamp took in 417.5 million, while OKX shed 271.4 million and Bitfinex shed 70.7 million.
author: jordan
